blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: A support app shows a streamed reply that includes a tool call. When may it run the tool?

options.text: After the block holding it has stopped and its joined fragments have parsed
options.says: The page says "do not act on a tool call until its block has stopped and its input has parsed".

options.text: As soon as the tool name appears in the opening event of the block
options.says: Ruled out because "The input is incomplete until the block stops".

options.text: Whenever the first fragment turns out to be a complete object
options.says: Ruled out because a fragment is not an object: "the fragment is not an object, and the object that comes is not final until the block ends".

options.text: Before the text, because tool blocks are always listed in front
options.says: Ruled out because "content lists the blocks in index order", not by kind.

questions.stem: Which pair of behaviours does a correct assembler show for an unrecognised event type and for a stream that ends early?

options.text: It skips both and returns the content it holds
options.says: Ruled out because a cut stream "is an incomplete message, not a short one".

options.text: It raises on the first and returns what the second gave
options.says: Ruled out on both halves: the page skips the first, since "the API may add new event types" under its versioning policy, and the second "is an incomplete message, not a short one", so no result comes from it.

options.text: It skips the first and raises on the second
options.says: The page says to "ignore event types you do not know" and that a stream without `message_stop` "is an incomplete message, not a short one".

options.text: It raises on both so that nothing is guessed
options.says: Ruled out because the first is skipped: "ignore event types you do not know".

questions.stem: A team adds streaming to a feature. Which of the problems below does it leave unchanged?

options.text: A proxy that drops quiet connections during long generations
options.says: Ruled out because "Events keep arriving, so a proxy never sees an idle connection".

options.text: The share of the rate limit that each reply uses
options.says: The page says "Streamed calls count against the same limits as the others", so the share of the limit is unchanged.

options.text: A visitor who sees no text during the first seconds
options.says: Ruled out because "The first words appear at once".

options.text: A very long answer that a plain call would refuse to start
options.says: Ruled out because "the SDKs refuse a non-streaming request that they expect to take longer than about ten minutes", which streaming avoids.

questions.stem: A stream holds a thinking block, a text block and a tool block. In which order does an assembler list them?

options.text: By how many fragments each one received
options.says: Ruled out because blocks are "never sorted by type or by size", and a fragment count is a size.

options.text: By the moment at which each one finished
options.says: Ruled out because the order is "not in the order they stopped".

options.text: With thinking first, text next and tools last
options.says: Ruled out because "Blocks are never sorted by type".

options.text: By the index that the events give each one
options.says: The page says "content lists the blocks in index order".
